Agents earn trust through a bonded stake locked to a unique hardware pigment fingerprint, so one physical device cannot spawn many identities. Honest agents also deposit a slow-vesting glacier bond that only unlocks after sustained good behavior, making short-lived attack accounts unprofitable.
